target_customer: Retail crypto investors wanting passive diversified exposure
problem: Retail users find it hard to pick and rebalance crypto assets; Hedgehog offers basket-based robo-advice.
business_model: Consumer fintech app (fees on managed crypto baskets, custodial product)

founders.name: Taylor Culbertson
founders.background_notes: Programmer and filmmaker; CEO of Infinite Sum consultancy

technical_complexity.rationale: Portfolio rebalancing plus custody and app-store apps in a crypto setting; standard fintech engineering with regulatory complexity.

defensibility.rationale: Basket crypto products were easy to copy; the SEC exit interview claim hints at regulatory friction rather than a moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not researched; no sourced information on incumbent behavior.

market_need_then: Company claimed 15k users monitoring $176m in assets and $548k GTV on V1 by 2021-22 (own YC profile, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Hedgehog was a crypto robo-adviser in YC S21 that took a seed round in August 2021 backed by YC and Dragonfly and claimed 15k users on V1. YC now lists it as Inactive, but no source I could open states a shutdown, its date or its cause, so the cause is not public in the material reviewed and no failure factors are asserted.
